improvement.flashlight.description: A powerful electric lamp whose light lets you explore the darkest places without fear.
improvement.flashlight.name: flashlight
improvement.master_key.description: A key ring so absurdly loaded that it promises to open every lock in the region to whoever has the patience to use it.
improvement.master_key.name: master key
improvement.mirror_pass.description: Many mirrors were once enchanted to create a sanctuary outside space and time. This power lets you pass through these portals at will.
improvement.mirror_pass.name: mirror pass
improvement.skeleton_key.description: An old bronze key without teeth, yet able to unlock what should never open. Its enchantment overrides most supernatural protections.
improvement.skeleton_key.name: skeleton key
improvement.supernatural_perception.desc: Opens your senses to the invisible world until you revoke this power. While you sense magic and the entities bound to it, you lose part of your ordinary perceptions.
improvement.supernatural_perception.name: supernatural perception
